questions.cardText:
[Philosophy] What does Plato’s “Allegory of the Cave” imply?
A. Reality is an illusion
B. Perception might not be the true form of reality
C. Life is a journey
Answer: B. Plato’s allegory depicts a scenario where humans understand reality only through shadows on a cave wall, hinting at the potential limitations of our sensory perceptions.
questions.en: In Plato’s Allegory of the Cave, what do the chained prisoners take for reality?
questions.de: Was halten die gefesselten Gefangenen in Platons Höhlengleichnis für die Wirklichkeit?

timeline.labelEn: Plato writes the Republic, whose Book VII contains the Allegory of the Cave
timeline.labelDe: Platon verfasst die Politeia, deren siebtes Buch das Höhlengleichnis enthält

questions.notes: Card's multiple choice (answer B: perception might not be the true form of reality) reworked to the allegory's core image; the shadows and sounds are the prisoners' sole reality.

questions.cardText:
[Geology] What is the primary cause of karst topography?
A. Dissolution of soluble rocks
B. Erosion by wind
C. Volcanic activity
Answer: A. Karst topography results in unique features like sinkholes, caves, and underground rivers, commonly found in areas with abundant limestone.
questions.en: By what process do soluble rocks such as limestone form karst topography, with its sinkholes, caves and underground rivers?
questions.de: Durch welchen Vorgang bilden lösliche Gesteine wie Kalkstein eine Karstlandschaft mit Dolinen, Höhlen und unterirdischen Flüssen?

timeline.labelEn: Jovan Cvijić publishes Das Karstphänomen, founding karst geomorphology
timeline.labelDe: Jovan Cvijić veröffentlicht „Das Karstphänomen“ und begründet die Karstgeomorphologie

questions.notes: Also accepted: chemical weathering / corrosion of carbonate rock.
